metadata.description: The organisation's AI SDLC standard for Claude Code: the AI-native loop from PRD to verified pull request, with stack packs for Airflow, micro-frontends and the React frontend.

plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: The six-stage AI-native SDLC loop (Plan, Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Maintain) from a Confluence PRD to a verified draft PR: PRD gate with product-owner feedback and intent.md, human-approved spec, accepted plan, test-first build, fail-to-pass and plan evidence, PR review loop, control bands and triage, learning. Hooks enforce the gates.
